result.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('vpc',(SELECT to_jsonb(v) FROM network_vpcs v WHERE vpc_id='vpc_a43ae8279bd54524bcf3f7f137e6a2d4'),'base',(SELECT to_jsonb(b) FROM network_vpc_base_connectivity b WHERE vpc_id='vpc_a43ae8279bd54524bcf3f7f137e6a2d4'),'eip',(SELECT to_jsonb(e) FROM network_eips e WHERE eip_id='eip_bb1caa4c7b204c2da11a43fc57151784'),'snat',(SELECT to_jsonb(s) FROM network_snat_bindings s WHERE snat_id='snat_6f56ca5c087e4d1fa49670684d011207'),'claim',(SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM network_eip_claims c WHERE eip_id='eip_bb1caa4c7b204c2da11a43fc57151784'),'operations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',operation_id,'kind',kind,'state',state,'created_at',created_at,'completed_at',completed_at)) FROM network_operations WHERE vpc_id='vpc_a43ae8279bd54524bcf3f7f137e6a2d4' OR eip_id='eip_bb1caa4c7b204c2da11a43fc57151784' OR snat_id='snat_6f56ca5c087e4d1fa49670684d011207'));
